META_DESCRIPTION: Track fuel, insurance, transit passes, and ride-sharing. FincWin's Transport envelope shows the true cost of getting around.
HERO_H1:
Getting from A to B
costs more than you think.
HERO_SUB: Gas, insurance, registration, Uber, parking, transit passes — transport is the category that spreads across your whole life. FincWin pulls it all into one envelope.
PAIN_H2:
Transport spending is scattered
across a dozen transactions.
PAIN_ITEM_1_H3: Fuel costs vary wildly and silently
PAIN_ITEM_1_P: When gas goes from $3.20 to $4.10/gallon you feel it at the pump. But you've never totalled it across the month. Your fuel spend swings by $60–$90 and you rarely catch it.
PAIN_ITEM_2_P: $14 here, $22 there. By month-end, your Uber and Lyft spend is $180 — more than your subway pass — and you have nothing to show for it because each trip felt small.
PAIN_ITEM_3_P: Registration, annual inspection, insurance renewal — these hit in large chunks. Without a system, you're always caught off guard by the $480 car insurance payment in March.
FEATURES_H2:
The Transport envelope:
every mile accounted for.
CARD_1_P: Fuel, insurance, transit, Uber — one envelope that holds all transport costs. One number that tells you if you're on pace or overspending this month.
CARD_2_P: Log your annual insurance renewal as a quarterly expense. FincWin spreads the impact across four months so the payment never blindsides you.
CARD_3_P: See your monthly fuel spend charted over time. Spot the months when gas prices drove your transport costs above your envelope cap. Plan smarter.
